Claim 1 (Currently amended): A gas generator comprising: a composition containing an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent, and a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent, said percentages stated by weight of the total composition; and a desiccant __in operable communication with said composition to enhance thermal stability__.

Claim 6 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said alkali metal chlorate is potassium chlorate __and is present in an amount of about 35-70 weight percent__.

Claim 7 (Currently amended): The gas generator of claim 1 wherein said carboxylic acid is selected from tartaric acid and its isomers, __including DL-tartaric acid, succinic acid, glutamic acid, adipic acid, and mucic acid, and mixtures thereof__.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A composition comprising: an alkali metal chlorate as an oxidizer provided at about 25-75 weight percent; a carboxylic acid as a fuel provided at about 25-75 weight percent; and a desiccant provided at about 5-35 weight-percent __to enhance the thermal stability of the composition__, said percentages stated by weight of the total gas generant composition.
